email.subject: Cool Breeze's website might be losing you calls
email.body:
Hi Ben,

I took a look at Cool Breeze Co's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no Google reviews showing, and your hours aren't listed anywhere. For an HVAC company, people checking if you're open now or trustworthy enough to call will often just leave and pick a competitor instead. The page is also slow to load from oversized images, which doesn't help.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what I'd change and why? No pressure either way.

Alex
Northlight Web
